note: Pre-2015 format: Answer any 5 of 10, all 10 marks, ~500 words each

questions.text: What are the key issues in the study of cognitive Psychology? Discuss the distinctive research methods of cognitive psychology.
What are the principles of information processing? Discuss the Cognitive Information Processing Model (CIPM) of learning.
What are the neurological issues related to memory? Describe the neural process of learning and memory.
Discuss the constructs that have been borrowed by PASS theory from the fields of neurology and information processing.
Define intelligence tests and explain the theoretical background of measurement of intelligence.
Compare and contrast the behaviouristic and innateness theories of language acquisition.
Describe the various processes involved in multilingualism.
Compare and contrast the speech errors made by individuals in different speech disorders.
Critically evaluate the utility of artificial intelligence in problem solving.
Intellectual blocks in problem solving (short note)
